content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the interaction between the User Interface Event (UIE) timer and the RTC (Real-Time Clock) time setting operation. Specifically, when setting the RTC time to a future value while the UIE timer was active, the existing timer's expiration was earlier than the newly set RTC time. This caused the `rtc_timer_do_work` function to enter a loop, as it kept enqueuing new timers until the current RTC time was reached, leading to unintended behavior and potential system resource exhaustion. Disabling the UIE timer before setting the time and re-enabling it afterward ensures proper synchronization and prevents this looping issue.
